name: list_stores
description: Every store with its id, brand, brand id, time zone and whether it is open now. Use the ids in the other tools' 'where'.

name: sales
description: Net sales, orders and average check per store, per day or in total, for a date range in each store's own time zone. Today's figures are what has been rung up so far.

where.description: A store id, 'brand:<brand id>', 'set:<store id>,<store id>,…' for several stores, or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

group.description: One row per store (default), per day, or one total.

name: sales_by_hour
description: Net sales and orders for each opening hour of one day, on each store's own clock. For today it also gives the usual for each hour (average of the last four same weekdays).

where.description: A store id, 'brand:<brand id>', 'set:<store id>,<store id>,…' for several stores, or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

name: top_items
description: Best-selling menu items by net sales for a date range, with quantities.

where.description: A store id, 'brand:<brand id>', 'set:<store id>,<store id>,…' for several stores, or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

limit.description: How many items, up to 25. Defaults to 10.

name: staff
description: Today's shifts: who is on, who hasn't clocked in, hours this week and labor cost so far. For one store it lists every shift; for several stores it gives a summary per store.

where.description: A store id, 'brand:<brand id>', 'set:<store id>,<store id>,…' for several stores, or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

name: inventory
description: Stock on hand from today's count, the par level, and how much is usually used the rest of today. For several stores only low items are listed.

where.description: A store id, 'brand:<brand id>', 'set:<store id>,<store id>,…' for several stores, or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

name: temperatures
description: Latest fridge and freezer readings with their safe ranges, and how many readings were out of range in the last six hours.

where.description: A store id, 'brand:<brand id>', 'set:<store id>,<store id>,…' for several stores, or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

name: delivery_apps
description: Whether each store is taking orders on each delivery app right now, and orders from each app today.

where.description: A store id, 'brand:<brand id>', 'set:<store id>,<store id>,…' for several stores, or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

name: insights
description: What the store's insight board shows now: anything that needs someone right now, things to plan for today, and the day's key facts (sales pace, busiest hour ahead, who's on shift). Empty attention lists mean nothing needs attention.

where.description: A store id, 'brand:<brand id>', 'set:<store id>,<store id>,…' for several stores, or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'.
